Emma (Finance): Heads up — NeoHealth flagged an unexpected burst invoice alongside reserved commit lines for Feb 21 (00:30-01:10 UTC). Looks like they were billed twice for the same work. Can billing verify?
Luke (Billing): Looking at INV-2026-0451. There's a reserved commit line and a separate 'burst' line for nodepool nh-prod-3 in the same minute ranges.
Priya (CS): NeoHealth had a small cross-region failover for canary traffic at ~00:42 UTC. We thought traffic would fall back to reserved pool, not incur burst.
Tomas (Ops): Pulling metering export now. If the router retried and created a transient VM attachment, our meter exporter may have recorded both pools.
billing-bot: Auto-check: invoice INV-2026-0451 shows overlapping meter IDs between reserved_bucket and burst_bucket for nodepool nh-prod-3. Recommend manual audit.
Emma (Finance): Requesting metering CSV for nh-prod-3 00:25-01:15 UTC and any routing logs that show pool assignment.
Tomas (Ops): Exported. Quick excerpt:```
2026-02-21T00:42:11Z nh-prod-3 reserved_bucket tokens=9,120 meter_id=mi-88b2
2026-02-21T00:42:11Z nh-prod-3 burst_bucket tokens=9,120 meter_id=mi-88b2
```
Priya (CS): That meter_id duplication confirms double-count. Customer already emailed their AP team. We should propose an interim credit.
Nora (AcctMgr): Agreed. Suggest provisional credit to give them immediate relief + a short goodwill concession. Tomas, any ETA on root cause and fix?
Tomas (Ops): Root cause: exporter dedupe key used vm_attach_id which was not unique on retry. Fix landed in runtime repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2473 deployed 2026-02-23 15:20 UTC. Full audit CSV uploaded: s3://redwood-billing-audits/2026-02/neohealth-dup-2398765432.csv
Luke (Billing): Emma, rough overcharge estimate?
Emma (Finance): Duplicated tokens ~= 9,120 => approx $72. With tax/rounding propose provisional credit $90. Also offer 5 days waived burst allowance as goodwill.
Priya (CS): Customer success supports the goodwill offer. We should also offer a short note explaining the cause in non-technical terms.
Luke (Billing): I can create a provisional credit memo but need Nora to approve. I'll tag it as provisional_credit and hold final adj until Ops confirms vendor-side if applicable.
Nora (AcctMgr): Approved for provisional credit $90. Please create memo and send customer note after I review.
Luke (Billing): Created credit memo CM-2026-PROV-205. Billing note: credit_reason=duplicate_meter_export_retry. Applied to INV-2026-0451 on 2026-03-12.
billing-bot: Ticket created: BILL-3650 - "NeoHealth duplicate metering - provisional credit issued" assigned to Luke.
Emma (Finance): Good. Tomas — did cloud provider (AWS/GCP) report anything on their side about duplicate export samples?
Tomas (Ops): Reached out to cloud-metering@provider.com; they replied they saw duplicate attach events for the instance due to a guest attach retry. They're correlating logs.
Priya (CS): I'll prepare the customer-facing email draft. Nora please review before send. Suggested wording: "We've applied a provisional credit of $90 and are completing an audit. A final reconciliation will be provided within 7 business days."
Nora (AcctMgr): Works for me. I'll review and send after Ops confirms vendor notes.
Emma (Finance): Thanks all. Marking this thread waiting-on-provider. Please update BILL-3650 with final reconciliation when ready.
Luke (Billing): Noted — provisional credit applied. Will update when final numbers confirmed.
Emma (Finance): Closing loop for now. :white_check_mark:
